title: ビッグペインを知ってこそ

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: My voice is completely back to normal, but my running…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Dammit! I'm going to do one more lap, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (My heart wants nothing more than to run! But my legs…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a certain distance, she suddenly starts slowing down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her epiglottic entrapment isn't just hindering her abilities. It's put a huge damper on her mood.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… I guess…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I didn't get it at all… I can't believe I acted all high and mighty with El back then…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Back at summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: El, you're certainly very gifted. However…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Don't let it go to your head! You have to remember to consider the feelings and positions of those less talented.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Many people are out there struggling to do what comes naturally to you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I never realized how frustrating it is to want to do something but not have the ability to do it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This irritation and sense of helplessness… I've never tasted such bitter medicine before. I'll have to redraw my path to the world stage from scratch…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl is utterly devastated, but just then…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I know my starts can be even better than this. I can still be smoother and faster!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Huh? Isn't that…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant… It's not enough… At this speed, everyone'll catch up with me in no time…

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: If I don't change myself, then there's just no way I can steal the lead at the Mile Championship…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Other Umamusume who are going to be running in the Mile Championship are also training on the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One of them is Silence Suzuka, a front runner who seems to be having trouble with her technique. Aside from her, there's also…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I've gotta do my best! I need to squeeze out all the effort I can—like when I'm squeezing balls of mochi!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm… That was no buono at all. I feel like I was a much more flavorful stew before…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is a big Umamusume, both in body and heart. She's good at sprints and mile races, but she seems to be in a slump.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It feels like we're standing in the Asphodel Fields…
choice_data_list: The Asphodel Fields… Do you mean it feels like we're in hell?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Look how dull and hopeless everyone is. None of them are chasing their dreams. They're just trying to find a way out.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And I'm just like them, trying to get out of here. I have to get it together before the Mile Championship…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like she says, everyone around us looks like they're struggling with something. The Twinkle Series may be glamorous, but there's two sides to every coin.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Everyone goes through slumps, but the real challenge lies in whether they can pull themselves out of them.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I think I'm going to try experimenting with a few more techniques. Maybe referencing my previous running styles will help.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I might not be able to find a new way to run… but then again, I also just might.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm going to do my best to get the buono back inside me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll try to run like I did before so I can remember the recipe I used to use.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Everyone's so determined.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I have no choice but to forge ahead. That's why I'll keep challenging myself again and again…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But sometimes, I wonder if I can still do it. This unexpected illness has knocked me down so far…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I pause to think and realize something. Compared to Silence Suzuka and Hishi Akebono…
choice_data_list: Finding your way might be easier than you think.
Finding your way might be easier than you think.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What? Really? Why do you say that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's one thing that really sets her apart from the other two, and that is…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: No turning back…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ah, I see what you mean. I can't go back to the way I ran before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she's finally realized that, by declining the surgery, there's no easy way for her to recover. In other words…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has to find a completely new method of running. The only way open to her… is forward.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm glad I know what I have to do. It takes the guesswork out of things.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's do this, Trainer! The deeper the despair, the greater the hope that comes from it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And… there's one more thing that's really important. Those who have never been sick cannot speak of illness.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If I run in my current state, I'll be able to send a message of hope to those around the world who are also dealing with health conditions!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend many days searching for an answer, until one day, we finally find a clue…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah! I need to reserve even more energy in my legs until…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Okay! Now's the time! As long as I can't catch my breath, there's no way I can compete at full strength…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: But if that's the case, then I'll just improve my explosive power further! I've no choice but to run a mile as if it were a sprint!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to circumvent the issues presented by her limited stamina, we focus on polishing her acceleration and speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may be slightly cracked, but Seeking the Pearl has found a way to overcome her difficulties and transform herself into a new type of shining pearl.
